name: tedtoolkit-career
description: Career-profile, resume, job-matching, and role-specific interview workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain career evidence and create job materials
interface.longDescription: Factual, evidence-led workflows for maintaining local career profiles, matching candidate evidence to job descriptions, writing and reviewing resumes, preparing candidates, and designing fair interviews.
defaultPrompt: Maintain a factual local career profile as the source for later career materials.
Match supplied evidence to a job description, then write or review only the requested resume artifact.
Use candidate interview preparation separately from interviewer plan design.
